etymology: Phono-semantic: forest (林) + 鹿 (phonetic ロク) — the wooded base where deer graze: the mountain's foot.
mnemonic: Where the deer wait out the altitude — ふもと. 麓: base camp's address.

etymology: Phono-semantic: flesh (月) + 劦 (phonetic キョウ) — the body's side: flank, armpit.
mnemonic: Where the arm keeps its secrets — わき. 脇役: the supporting role, at the lead's side.

components: well (井) with a dot in it
etymology: Ideograph: something dropped into the well (井) — the plunk: donburi, the deep bowl.
mnemonic: The well with dinner at the bottom — どんぶり. 牛丼, 親子丼: the dot is your meal.

etymology: Phono-semantic: person (亻) + 敖 (phonetic ゴウ) — carrying oneself high: arrogant (傲慢).
mnemonic: The chin at altitude — ゴウ. 傲慢: pride minus the earning — Silver's kanji, apparition #2.

etymology: From Sanskrit kṣetra — the temple grounds (古刹); the instant (刹那).
mnemonic: Sacred ground, split-second — セツ. 刹那: the moment before it's gone.

etymology: Phono-semantic: mouth (口) + 甫 (phonetic ホ) — fed at the mouth: to nurse — 哺乳類, the mammals.
mnemonic: The class of animals defined by dinner — ホ. 哺乳類: us, taxonomically.

etymology: Phono-semantic: mouth (口) + 兪 (phonetic ユ) — meaning ferried across: metaphor (比喩).
mnemonic: One thing said in another's boat — ユ. 比喩: the figure of speech.

etymology: Phono-semantic: mouth/nose (口) + 臭 (phonetic キュウ) — taking the scent: to sniff.
mnemonic: The nose's active voice — かぐ. 嗅覚: the detective's sense.

etymology: Phono-semantic: mouth (口) + 朝 (phonetic チョウ) — the jeering mouth: to mock (嘲笑).
mnemonic: Laughter aimed, not shared — あざける. 自嘲: the mirror version.

etymology: Compound: the vessel struck (殳) to pieces — to destroy; reputations too (毀損).
mnemonic: The pot and the good name, both smashable — キ. 名誉毀損: defamation, legally.

etymology: Originally the hedgehog — bristling with like things: collection: 語彙, vocabulary.
mnemonic: The hedgehog of words, one spine each — イ. 語彙: your vocabulary count.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 次 (phonetic シ) + heart (心) — the heart doing as it pleases: arbitrary (恣意的).
mnemonic: Rules made of whim — シ. 恣意的: the criticism in academic reviews.

etymology: Phono-semantic: heart (忄) + 具 (phonetic ク) — the wary heart: dread — 危惧, the feared outcome.
mnemonic: The heart checking its toolkit and finding worry — ク. 危惧: endangered species' epithet.

etymology: Phono-semantic: heart (忄) + 栗 (phonetic リツ) — trembling like a leaf: to shudder (戦慄).
mnemonic: The chestnut-burr chill up the spine — リツ. 戦慄: horror's professional term.

etymology: Phono-semantic: heart (忄) + 景 (phonetic ケイ) — the heart lit by a distant view: to aspire — 憧憬.
mnemonic: The postcard the heart keeps — ケイ. 憧憬: longing, framed.

etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + 立 (phonetic ラツ/ラ) — dragged off: abduction (拉致); also ramen's 拉 (拉麺).
mnemonic: Pulled off one's feet — ラ. 拉致 and 拉麺: the kanji's two very different jobs.

etymology: Compound: the gift gripped (執) in both hands (手) — earnest offering: sincerity (真摯).
mnemonic: Held out with both hands, no hedging — シ. 真摯: the apology adverb bosses want.

etymology: Phono-semantic: sun (日) + 愛 (phonetic アイ) — the sun veiled: dim — 曖昧, ambiguity.
mnemonic: Love clouding the daylight — アイ. 曖昧: the answer that isn't one.

etymology: Phono-semantic: wood (木) + 皆 (phonetic カイ) — the model tree: the standard block script: 楷書.
mnemonic: Kanji standing at attention — カイ. 楷書: the font you learned first.

components: trees crowding a dense core (29 strokes)
etymology: Compound: vegetation choked dense — pent up: depression (憂鬱). Famously the hardest Jōyō kanji: 29 strokes.
mnemonic: The forest with no path out, drawn in full — ウツ. 鬱: even writing it is heavy.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 辟 (phonetic ヘキ) + jade (玉) — the flawless ritual disc: perfection — 完璧.
mnemonic: The jade with zero excuses — ヘキ. 完璧: note the 玉, not 土 — perfection is a jewel, not dirt.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 疒 + 昜 (phonetic ヨウ) — the festering swelling: ulcer (潰瘍).
mnemonic: The stomach's protest note — ヨウ. 胃潰瘍: stress, published internally.

etymology: Phono-semantic: bamboo (⺮) + 戔 (phonetic セン) — the note slip: label — 付箋, the sticky note; 処方箋, the prescription.
mnemonic: The small paper with big authority — セン. 処方箋: the pharmacy's password.

etymology: Phono-semantic: bamboo (⺮) + 龍 (phonetic ロウ) — the woven cage: basket; shut inside: to seclude (籠る).
mnemonic: A basket strong enough to hold a dragon — かご. 引き籠り: the self-woven basket.

etymology: Phono-semantic: thread (糸) + 致 (phonetic チ) — woven to the last strand: precise — 緻密.
mnemonic: Detail down to the thread count — チ. 緻密: the engineer's compliment.

etymology: Compound: the offering presented — and the flush of presenting oneself: shame — 羞恥心.
mnemonic: The blush at being served up — シュウ. 羞恥心: the shyness organ.

etymology: Phono-semantic: words (言) + 卜 (phonetic フ) — the death notice: obituary (訃報).
mnemonic: The news no one wants to deliver — フ. 訃報: the black-bordered word.

etymology: Phono-semantic: words (言) + 皆 (phonetic カイ) — voices agreeing: harmony — 俳諧, the haikai verse.
mnemonic: Everyone's words in tune — カイ. 俳諧: Bashō's genre.

etymology: Compound: treasure (貝) wanted now (今) — greed: to covet (貪欲).
mnemonic: 'Mine, immediately' — むさぼる. 貪欲: hunger with a portfolio — also a compliment in sports.

etymology: Phono-semantic: foot (足) + 宗 (phonetic ソウ) — the trail of steps: whereabouts — 失踪, vanishing.
mnemonic: Footprints that stop mid-page — ソウ. 失踪: the missing-person file.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 辛 'spicy' + 束 (phonetic ラツ) — heat concentrated: pungent — 辛辣, scathing.
mnemonic: Spice at critique strength — ラツ. 辛辣: reviews that leave marks; 辣油: the oil version.

etymology: Phono-semantic: metal (金) + 固 (phonetic コ) — sealed in metal: confinement — 禁錮, imprisonment.
mnemonic: The cell door's alloy — コ. 禁錮: the sentence in years.

etymology: Phono-semantic: earth (土) + 眞 (phonetic テン) — packed full: to fill — 補塡, covering a shortfall.
mnemonic: The hole made whole — テン. 補塡: accounting's spackle.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 夾 (phonetic キョウ) + head (頁) — the face's sides: cheeks.
mnemonic: Where the face stores its blush — ほお. 頰張る: cheeks at capacity.

etymology: Phono-semantic: mouth (口) + 七 (phonetic シツ) — the sharp rebuke: to scold (𠮟る) — the Jōyō form of 叱.
mnemonic: Seven words, all pointed — しかる. 𠮟る: firm, brief, over.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 彔 (phonetic ハク) + blade (刂) — stripped away: to peel — 剝がす.
mnemonic: The sticker's slow surrender — はがす. 剝離: coming apart in layers.
